question: How should Śiva with his six limbs be worshipped in this stage of the rite?
premises: Śiva is worshipped together with his six limbs.
The worship is accompanied by specific offerings.
Fuel sticks, clarified butter, and food are used.
inference: Śiva together with his six limbs should be worshipped with fuel sticks, clarified butter, and food.
plain_english: Having worshipped Śiva together with his six limbs, one should do so with fuel sticks, clarified butter, and food.
